title.narrative: Integrated food security project in Kassala, Sudan (IFSP-Kassala)

description.narrative: Considering the challenging food-gap and the nutritional status of the targeted population the projects overall goal (or Ultimate Outcome) has been defined as: "Improved food and nutrition security of the targeted population in Kassala, especially for women and youth." In order to contribute to the achievement of this goal three interlinked components have been identified, namely: Component 1: "Agricultural Production <(>&<)> Productivity" Component 2: "Employment and Livelihood Opportunities" Component 3: "Community Participation <(>&<)> Empowerment" While component 1 and 2 are linked together and complement each other within the context of a value-chain perspective, component 3 provides the entry point whilst at the same time ensures sustainability.
